BambooHR sells one of the most widely used applicant tracking systems in the small-business market and recruits for itself on Greenhouse. That irony is the first thing you learn when you search for a BambooHR internship, and it is verifiable in seconds: every apply link on bamboohr.com/careers resolves to[job-boards.greenhouse.io/bamboohr17](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bamboohr17) . The second thing you learn is that there is nothing to apply to right now. BambooHR’s own internships page renders “No open positions,” and the Greenhouse board confirms it: of **33 live requisitions** on September 10, 2026, not one is an internship. The company was founded in **Lindon, Utah in 2008** by Ben Peterson and Ryan Sanders, reached **1,200 employees, 30,000 customers and 3 million users** by 2023, and now calls itself “a major player in the HCM market.” Its internship programme is real and recent — a[September 2025 Glassdoor review](https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Employee-Review-BambooHR-E676898-RVW99928561.htm) from a current Software Developer intern praised the one-on-one mentorship and pay — but BambooHR’s own Head of Legal and HR has stated publicly that the company “cannot guarantee full-time roles in every case” and that “there is a budget consideration for every headcount investment.” The programme is small, budget-gated, and worth watching for exactly because of that honesty.

## What Is a BambooHR Internship?


A BambooHR internship is a placement at a privately held HR technology company headquartered in Lindon, Utah, in the Silicon Slopes corridor between Provo and Salt Lake City. BambooHR builds an all-in-one HCM platform covering HR data and reporting, payroll, benefits administration, time and attendance, applicant tracking, onboarding, performance management, compensation management, compliance training and Employer of Record services for **more than 33,000 customers and 3 million users** worldwide. The company was founded in 2008 by Ben Peterson and Ryan Sanders, is led by CEO **Brad Rencher** (since 2019), and reached 1,200 employees by 2023. Intern reviews confirm one-on-one mentorship, real team membership, autonomy and good pay, with placements documented in **Marketing** and **Software Development** . BambooHR is also known for **Paid Paid Vacation** , a benefit introduced in 2015 where the company pays employees to take their holiday. It rates **3.7 out of 5 on Glassdoor** from 793 reviews, with work-life balance and culture both at 4.0, and **3.9 out of 5 on Indeed** from 94 reviews.


## When Do BambooHR Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


BambooHR publishes no internship recruiting calendar, no application window and no deadline. The internships page at bamboohr.com/careers/internships filters the Greenhouse board on intern-flagged roles and currently shows “No open positions.” The programme is real — dated Glassdoor intern reviews exist from 2019, 2024 and 2025 across Marketing and Software Development — but it is small and budget-gated. BambooHR’s own Head of Legal and HR has publicly described intern headcount as tied to “future business needs” with “a budget consideration for every headcount investment.” The honest timeline for a student is: check monthly, apply the moment something appears, and in the meantime build experience elsewhere or apply to the entry-level full-time roles (Business Development Representative, Client Service Specialist, Payroll Support Hero) that are open now.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


BambooHR’s internship programme is small and budget-gated, and the company has said so in public. Its Head of Legal and HR told a departing intern on Glassdoor that “there is a budget consideration for every headcount investment we make” and that BambooHR “continue\[s\] to refine our processes to try to connect intern opportunities to future business needs.” When a programme this size posts a requisition, the window is narrow and the seats are few. The Greenhouse board is the fastest signal: the public API at boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/bamboohr17/jobs loads in under a second and shows every live requisition with its updated date. Check it monthly. When an internship appears, apply within the first week. Meanwhile, BambooHR’s entry-level full-time roles — Business Development Representative, Client Service Specialist, Payroll Support Hero, Amendment Specialist 1, HR Services Advisor — are open now and are the realistic near-term door for graduating students.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


BambooHR publishes no internship eligibility criteria. There is no GPA, class year, major, enrollment requirement or work-authorization statement on its internships page, careers page or any live requisition. What follows is inferred from intern reviews and the company’s own published candidate guidance:


• **Departments confirmed:** Marketing (2019 intern) and Software Development (2025 intern). The careers page lists eight department landing pages: Marketing, Product, Finance & Legal, Engineering & IT, Human Resources, Sales, Business Operations, Customer Experience & Support, and Payroll Implementation.


• **Remote eligibility:** at least one intern placement has been fully remote (2024 intern’s first listed pro was “Remote”). Most live roles are Utah hybrid, with some remote across Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Nebraska, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah and Virginia.


• **Work authorization:** not published. BambooHR states no visa or sponsorship policy for interns anywhere on its careers site.


• **GPA:** not published. No GPA threshold appears on any BambooHR page or in any recoverable requisition.


### What BambooHR Does Publish for Candidates


The closest thing BambooHR has to a stated candidate expectation is its[AI Guidelines for Candidates](https://www.bamboohr.com/about-bamboohr/careers/ai-guidelines-for-candidates) . The rules are clear: you may use AI to prepare your resume and research the company, but you must not “use a chatbot during interviews” and must not “use AI for any interview skills assessments or projects unless instructed.” BambooHR’s stated principle is “AI can be a helpful tool, but it’s never a substitute for human connection.” At an HR-tech company building Bamboo AI, being caught doing the thing they publicly asked you not to do is a specific and avoidable failure. BambooHR also recommends business casual for interviews: “pants and a button down, or your favorite dress/skirt with nice sneakers.”

## What Is the BambooHR Application and Interview Process Like?


BambooHR publishes no step-by-step hiring process for interns. No round-by-round description, no assessment detail and no timeline exists on any public page. What is documented:


1. **Check[bamboohr.com/careers/internships](https://www.bamboohr.com/careers/internships)** first. The page filters the live board on intern-flagged roles. When it says “No open positions,” there are none.


2. **Apply to a named opening, not the general resume drop.** BambooHR’s own FAQ: applications against a specific opening get reviewed and “we’ll reach out — no matter what — with an update”; a general resume submission means “we likely won’t contact you unless a position opens up that matches your experience.”


3. **Read the AI guidelines before you interview.** BambooHR publishes them at bamboohr.com/about-bamboohr/careers/ai-guidelines-for-candidates. Do not use a chatbot during interviews. Do not use AI for skills assessments or projects unless instructed.


4. **Expect a thank-you email first.** “First, you’ll receive a thank-you email to let you know we’ve received your application.”


5. **Interview rounds: not published.** BambooHR has not documented its interview format for interns. Dress code is business casual: “pants and a button down, or your favorite dress/skirt with nice sneakers.”


BambooHR commits to responding to every application against a specific opening, which is more than most employers promise. The honest gap is that you cannot apply right now because there is nothing to apply to. ## How Do You Stand Out at a Company That Publishes Almost Nothing About Its Internship?


Four moves, all executable now. First, check the Greenhouse API before anything else. The public endpoint at boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/bamboohr17/jobs shows every live requisition instantly. When an internship appears, apply within the first week — a budget-gated programme with small cohorts fills fast. Second, know the product specifically. Not “HR software” — know that BambooHR is an all-in-one HCM platform with payroll, benefits administration, ATS, performance, compensation management and Employer of Record, serving 33,000+ customers and 3 million users, and that its current push is AI (Bamboo AI, Ask BambooHR) and its core data platform. Third, follow the AI guidelines to the letter. BambooHR is one of the few employers that publishes candidate AI rules, and violating them at an HR-tech company that is building its own AI product is a specific and memorable failure. Fourth, prepare stories for BambooHR’s two most interview-actionable values: “Lead from Where You Are” (“People follow leaders, not titles”) and “Be Open” (“Never wait until tomorrow to say what will make us stronger today”). Have a story where you raised something uncomfortable early, and one where you drove something without being asked. And if you are graduating, look at the entry-level full-time roles (BDR, Client Service Specialist, Payroll Support Hero) instead — they are open now and several are fully remote across a dozen states.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 BambooHR internship?


No. BambooHR’s internships page currently renders “No open positions,” and the Greenhouse board confirms it: none of 33 live requisitions is an internship. The programme ran as recently as 2025, when a Software Developer intern reviewed it on Glassdoor, but nothing is posted for Summer 2027 yet. Check the internships page monthly.


### Where does BambooHR post its jobs?


On Greenhouse, under the board token bamboohr17. Every apply link resolves to job-boards.greenhouse.io/bamboohr17. BambooHR sells its own well-known applicant tracking system and does not use it to hire for itself. The public API at boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/bamboohr17/jobs shows every live requisition.


### How much do BambooHR interns get paid?


No figure is published, and Utah has no pay-transparency law requiring one. A software development intern reviewing in September 2025 listed “Good Pay” among the pros and rated compensation and benefits 4 out of 5. A 2019 marketing intern noted being able to contribute to a 401(k) as an intern, which is unusual. Ask the recruiter for the rate.


### Do BambooHR interns get a return offer?


Not necessarily. A 2025 intern’s stated con was “not always a job offer after even though it’s heavily implied.” BambooHR’s Head of Legal and HR replied on the record: “While we cannot guarantee full-time roles in every case, we want all team members to feel their time here is meaningful.” In a separate reply the company said every intern headcount is “a budget consideration.” Go for the mentorship and the experience, and ask what happened to the last cohort.


### Can BambooHR internships be remote?


At least one has been. A former intern reviewing in December 2024 listed “Remote” as the first pro. Most live BambooHR roles are Utah hybrid, with several remote across Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Nebraska, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah and Virginia.


### Can I use AI in a BambooHR interview?


Partly. BambooHR publishes candidate AI guidelines: use AI to prepare your resume and research the company, but do not use a chatbot during interviews and do not use AI for skills assessments or projects unless instructed. Their stated principle is “AI can be a helpful tool, but it’s never a substitute for human connection.”


### What is Paid Paid Vacation?


BambooHR’s signature benefit, introduced in 2015: the company pays for the vacation itself, on top of paid time off. Employees mention it unprompted in both five-star and two-star reviews. Other benefits include a 401(k) match with immediate vesting, company-paid life and short-term disability insurance, tuition reimbursement and an HSA match.


### What does BambooHR actually do?


BambooHR is an all-in-one HCM platform with solutions for HR data and reporting, payroll, benefits administration, time and attendance, applicant tracking, onboarding, performance management, compensation management, compliance training and Employer of Record. It serves more than 33,000 customers and 3 million users, and its customer list has included Shopify, Foursquare and Reddit.


BambooHR’s internship programme is small, budget-gated, and well worth watching for. While you wait for a requisition to appear, build the evidence: a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) turns “interested in HR tech” into a finished project a BambooHR application can point at. And if you are graduating, the entry-level full-time roles are open now.
